items.signal_prefix: Market outlook: the NAND market is estimated to EXCEED $300

set.signal: Market outlook: the NAND market is estimated to EXCEED $300 BILLION in calendar 2026 (up 3x YoY) and to APPROACH $500 BILLION in calendar 2027. Data center's share of total NAND TAM expands from ~30% in CY2025 to ~50% in CY2026 and continues outpacing the market in 2027. Demand from customers is growing faster than Sandisk's supply, so bits are expected to REMAIN ON ALLOCATION BEYOND CALENDAR 2027. CEO: 'We want to grow with the market. We plan to grow with the market.' Asked whether Sandisk would hold segment share of that market, the CFO answered 'That is correct' and the CEO 'For sure.'

items.reason: 'rather than outgrow it' is not said on the call; the CEO says Sandisk wants / plans to grow with the market (and 'We can grow in excess of the market rates we're talking about just through nodal transitions'); holding share is management's yes to an analyst question.
items.evidence: David Goeckeler: We want to grow with the market. We plan to grow with the market. ... Luis Visoso: That is correct.

set.signal: FQ1 FY2027 guidance: revenue $10.3-10.8B (growth from BOTH bit growth and modest price increases), non-GAAP gross margin 83-85%, opex $520-540M, non-GAAP EPS $44-46 on 155M diluted shares. The modest sequential gross-margin step-down from 84.6% is attributed to mix and prudent assumptions on component cost, NOT to NBM pricing (CFO: the new business models should not be assumed to be what moves gross margin - 'They are good margins.'). FY2027 capex rises in dollars to ramp BiCS8 and BiCS10 but falls to ~6% of revenue; sellable bit growth is trimmed to MID-TEENS for FY2027 (versus the mid-to-high-teens long-term objective) because higher inventory days are being carried to support NBMs and higher component costs.

items.reason: The quote is not verbatim: the speaker-labelled transcript (CFO Luis Visoso) reads 'are a drive on gross margin', not 'a drag'; replaced by an attributed paraphrase plus the verbatim 'They are good margins.'
items.evidence: Luis Visoso: Yeah. I would not assume that our new business models are a drive on gross margin. They are good margins.

items.signal_prefix: Technology and product: BiCS8 ramped to the MAJORITY of bit

set.signal: Technology and product: BiCS8 ramped to the MAJORITY of bit production this year across both TLC and QLC, enabled by CBA hybrid wafer bonding; BiCS10 announced and in ramp plans for FY2027 capex. The QLC STARGATE platform BEGAN SHIPPING FOR REVENUE this quarter, completing a portfolio spanning performance-intensive compute (TLC enterprise SSD, scaled across a broad set of hyperscale and AI infrastructure customers) and high-capacity AI data lakes. Supply grows primarily through NODAL TRANSITIONS rather than wafer additions. High Bandwidth Flash (HBF), first announced almost a year and a half ago, advanced: additions to the HBF advisory board this week, HBF performance simulations shown at the FMS keynote, and significant customers discussing the technology at FMS; shipping and release dates not yet disclosed. Asked about NVIDIA's CMX and Storage NEXT plans, the CEO said 'Yes, all these are opportunities for us.'
set.figure: BiCS8 majority of bits; BiCS10 announced; QLC Stargate first revenue; HBF advisory-board additions
